title_en: Marko sat down to have a little supper
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional epic about Krale Marko; his mother is Evrosima. Rendering of 'венча' and 'крсти' as marrying off / being godfather is my reading.

words_to_learn.en: to marry off, to crown (as best man)

lines.cyr: Еј, седнал Марко малку да вечера,
lines.lat: Ej, sednal Marko malku da večera,
lines.en: Hey, Marko sat down to have a little supper,
one message from the king of Budim,

lines.cyr: да му венча, Марко, мила сина.
lines.lat: da mu venča, Marko, mila sina.
lines.en: to crown Marko's dear son in marriage.

lines.cyr: Еј, други абер од Костура града:
lines.lat: Ej, drugi aber od Kostura grada:
lines.en: Hey, the second message from the town of Kostur:

lines.cyr: да му крсти Марко до два сина.
lines.lat: da mu krsti Marko do dva sina.
lines.en: to be godfather to Marko's two sons.
The third message from the town of Istanbul:

lines.cyr: цар го кани на крвава војна.
lines.lat: car go kani na krvava vojna.
lines.en: the sultan calls him to a bloody war.

lines.cyr: Еј, па ја праша Марко стара мајка:
lines.lat: Ej, pa ja praša Marko stara majka:
lines.en: Hey, then Marko asked his old mother:

lines.cyr: - Кажи мајко каде јас да одам,
lines.lat: - Kaži majko kade jas da odam,
lines.en: - Tell me, mother, where should I go,

lines.cyr: тебе мајко јас ќе те послушам?
lines.lat: tebe majko jas ḱe te poslušam?

lines.en: - If you go, Marko, to a wedding,
to a wedding you go, to a feast,
to a christening you go, for piety.

lines.cyr: Еј, иди сине во Стамбол на војна,
lines.lat: Ej, idi sine vo Stambol na vojna,
lines.en: Hey, go, son, to Istanbul to war,
if you want to earn a good deed.
and went off to the bloody war.
